Tencent HY 3D Global Billing Overview
Free CreditUpon first-time activation of the Tencent HY service, the following APIs will grant a free call tier for your testing experience. The free quota will be provided using a one-time free resource package and deducted first during billing and settlement. The free resource package is valid for 1 year. If the count of API calls in the free resource package is not used up within 1 year after service activation, it becomes invalid.By default, after the free resource package is used up or expires, it will not automatically switch to postpaid. If you have not purchased a prepaid resource package or have not actively activated the postpaid service, a billing exception error will occur. To use the postpaid mode for settlement, please go to ﻿ > Settings > Postpaid Settings to enable post-payment.Product SeriesAPI nameFree QuotaTencent HY 3D GlobalTencent HY 3D Global (Professional)200 credits/user﻿Tencent HY 3D Global (Express)﻿﻿3D Part Generation﻿﻿Smart Topology﻿﻿3D Texture Edit﻿﻿UV Unfold﻿﻿Auto Rigging﻿﻿Convert 3D Format﻿Billing ModeTencent HY 3D Global common credits resource package is applicable to Tencent HY 3D Global (Professional) API capability.Product SeriesAPI nameBasic Billing (Required)Tencent HY 3D GlobalTencent HY 3D Global (Professional)Resource package/Postpaid﻿Tencent HY 3D Global (Express)﻿﻿3D Part Generation﻿﻿Smart Topology﻿﻿3D Texture Edit﻿﻿UV Unfold﻿﻿Auto Rigging﻿﻿Convert 3D Format﻿Credits Resource Package (Prepaid)A resource package is valid for 1 year. If the credits in the resource package are not used up within 1 year from the date of purchase, they become invalid. After the resource package is used, the remaining credits cannot be put on hold or suspended. If a purchased resource package is not used, you can refund it within 7 days unconditionally. The resource package can only deduct the number of API calls generated after purchase.Service NamePrepaid Package Validity PeriodCredits QuantityResource Package Price (USD)Unit Price (USD/Credits)Tencent HY 3D Global1 year1,000150.015﻿﻿10,0001450.0145﻿﻿50,0007000.014﻿﻿100,0001,3500.0135Postpaid (By Credits)Postpaid adopts daily settlement. The bill for the previous day's usage is generated and charged daily.Tencent HY 3D Global related postpaid billing is based on credits, with the billing standard as follows:Service NameAPI nameUnit Price (USD/Credits)Tencent HY 3D GlobalTencent HY 3D Global (Professional)0.02Daily settlement﻿Tencent HY 3D Global (Express)﻿﻿﻿3D Part Generation﻿﻿﻿Smart Topology﻿﻿﻿3D Texture Edit﻿﻿﻿UV Unfold﻿﻿﻿Auto Rigging﻿﻿﻿Convert 3D Format﻿﻿Concurrency Additional Package (Prepaid)If no concurrency add-on package is purchased, the Tencent HY 3D Global (Professional) API has a default limit of 3 concurrency, while the Tencent HY 3D Global (Express) component generation API has a default limit of 1 concurrency. This limit is shared between main and sub-accounts. You can go to the Purchase Page to buy add-on packages to enhance the API concurrency limit.API NameMonthly purchaseTencent HY 3D Global (Professional)5,000 USD/concurrency/monthTencent HY 3D Global (Express)5,000 USD/concurrency/month3D Part Generation5,000 USD/concurrency/monthSmart Topology5,000 USD/concurrency/month3D Texture Edit5,000 USD/concurrency/monthUV Unfold5,000 USD/concurrency/monthAuto Rigging5,000 USD/concurrency/monthConvert 3D Format5,000 USD/concurrency/monthNote:Concurrency: the number of concurrent tasks that can be processed simultaneously. If the concurrency is m, at most m submitted tasks can be processed simultaneously at a time, and the next task can only be processed after the previous task is completed..You can purchase concurrency additional packages to increase the number of concurrent tasks based on the API default concurrency. For example, if the API provides m concurrency by default and you purchase n concurrency additional packages, your root account and sub-accounts can use m + n concurrency totally.Credits Deduction InstructionsTencent HY 3D Global (Professional)When using the Tencent HY 3D Global (Professional) API, calling different parameters will deduct different credits. By default, it is text/image-to-3D in ordinary texture mode, consuming 25 credits per call.Failed tasks do not deduct credits (no deduction for any failure, including failures caused by risk control policy).[Generate task type]The [GenerateType] parameter can be used to specify the task type. This is a required option, with [Normal] as the default option, which generates a 3D model with textures and consumes 25 credits.The [GenerateType] parameter offers other task types. Select 1 of 4 available 3D file patterns, consuming points based on the generation type.Generate task typeFeature DescriptionConsume CreditsNormalGenerate a textured geometry model25.00LowPolyGenerate a textured geometry model with intelligent mesh reduction30.00GeometryGenerate a geometry model without textures (white model)15.00SketchEnter a sketch or line drawing to generate a textured geometry model25.00[Additional Parameter]Can be used after selecting the task generation type. The following parameters allow multiple options and will accumulate credits consumption based on additional usage. Selecting version 3.0 or 3.1 from the [Model] parameter will not consume extra credits.Generate task typeFeature DescriptionAdditional Credits consumptionMultiViewImagesGenerate 3D models from multi-view10.00EnablePBRGenerate 3D models with PBR materials, including metallic, roughness, and normal textures10.00FaceCountGenerate 3D models with custom face counts10.00Tencent HY 3D Global (Express)When using the Tencent HY 3D Global (Express) API, calling different parameters will deduct different amounts of points. The default is generating 3D models from text or images, normal texture mode, which consumes 15 credits per use.Generate task typeFeature DescriptionAdditional Credits consumptionPromptGenerate 3D models from text15.00 credits/callImageUrl/ImageBase64Generate 3D models from images15.00 credits/call[Additional Parameter]Additional parameters are available. Credits consumption will accumulate based on extra usage.Generate task typeFeature DescriptionAdditional Credits consumptionEnablePBRGenerate 3D models with PBR materials, including metallic, roughness, and normal textures10.00 credits/callValue Added Feature (Post-Processing)During actual generation, calling different APIs will deduct different credits.Failed tasks do not deduct credits (no deduction for any failure, including failures caused by content risk control policy).Generate task typeFeature DescriptionAdditional Credits consumption3D Part GenerationAfter inputting the 3D model, the system can automatically identify the model structure and generate corresponding 3D components.30 credits/callSmart TopologyAfter inputting the 3D model, the system can generate an intelligent topology with a textured geometry model.50 credits/call3D Texture EditAfter the 3D model is input, the system can generate a texture map based on the original model according to a Prompt or an image.30 credits/callUV UnfoldAfter inputting the 3D model, a high-quality UV tangent model can be generated automatically.10 credits/callAuto RiggingInput a character or animal 3D model for rigging and skinning, and output a 3D model with skeletal information.10 credits/callConvert 3D FormatAfter inputting the 3D model, converted into model files in different formats.5 credits/callBilling and Settlement MethodThe settlement order for Tencent HY 3D Global is: purchased prepaid resource package > postpaid.In pay-as-you-go mode, billing is based on API calls (credits). Failed API calls are not charged.By default, after the prepaid resource package is used up or expires, it will not automatically switch to postpaid. To use the postpaid mode for settlement, go to the Tencent HY Console > Settings > Postpaid Settings to enable post-payment.Fees Calculation ExamplesPrepaid Resource PackageExample one:The user used the "LowPoly" generation mode in the [GenerateType] parameter and enabled the [PBR] parameter. Every API call will consume 30 + 10 = 40 (points).Example two:Users are expected to make 30,000 cumulative calls to Tencent HY 3D Global (Professional) API within one year. They can purchase three 10,000-credits Tencent HY 3D Global credits packages, and the fee required is calculated as follows:145 × 3 = 435 (USD)PostpaidThe user's cumulative calls to Tencent HY 3D Global (Professional) API on the current day amount to 1,000 credits. The user has 100 free points remaining in Tencent HY 3D Global. The fee required is calculated as follows:(1000 - 100) × 0.02 = 18 (USD)﻿

Common Params
Common parameters are used for all APIs authenticating requestors. Common parameters must be included in all API requests, and they will not be described in individual API documents.
The exact contents of the common parameters will vary depending on the version of the signature method you use.
Common parameters for Signature Algorithm v3When the TC3-HMAC-SHA256 algorithm is used, the common parameters should be uniformly placed in the HTTP request header, as shown below:
Parameter Name
Type
Required
Description
X-TC-Action
String
Yes
The name of the API for the desired operation. For the specific value, see the description of common parameter Action in the input parameters in related API documentation. For example, the API for querying the CVM instance list is DescribeInstances.
X-TC-Region
String
Yes
Region parameter, which is used to identify the region to which the data you want to work with belongs. For values supported for an API, see the description of common parameter Region in the input parameters in related API documentation. Note: This parameter is not required for some APIs (which will be indicated in related API documentation), and will not take effect even it is passed.
X-TC-Timestamp
Integer
Yes
The current UNIX timestamp that records the time when the API request was initiated, for example, 1529223702. Note: If the difference between the UNIX timestamp and the server time is greater than 5 minutes, a signature expiration error may occur.
X-TC-Version
String
Yes
API version of the action. For the valid values, see the description of the common input parameter Version in the API documentation. For example, the version of CVM is 2017-03-12.
Authorization
String
Yes
The HTTP authentication request header, for example: TC3-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=AKID***/Date/service/tc3_request, SignedHeaders=content-type;host, Signature=fe5f80f77d5fa3beca038a248ff027d0445342fe2855ddc963176630326f1024 Here: - TC3-HMAC-SHA256: Signature method, currently fixed as this value; - Credential: Signature credential; AKID*** is the SecretId; Date is a date in UTC time, and this value must match the value of X-TC-Timestamp (a common parameter) in UTC time format; service is the name of the product/service, and is generally a domain name prefix. For example, a domain name cvm.tencentcloudapi.com refers to the CVM product and the value would be cvm; - SignedHeaders: The headers that contains the authentication information; content-type and host are the required headers; - Signature: Signature digest.
X-TC-Token
String
No
The token used for a temporary certificate. It must be used with a temporary key. You can obtain the temporary key and token by calling a CAM API. No token is required for a long-term key.
Assuming you want to query the list of Cloud Virtual Machine instances in the Guangzhou region, the request structure in the form of request URL, request header and request body may be as follows:
Example of an HTTP GET request structure:
https://cvm.tencentcloudapi.com/?Limit=10&Offset=0
Authorization: TC3-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=AKID********************************/2018-10-09/cvm/tc3_request, SignedHeaders=content-type;host, Signature=5da7a33f6993f0614b047e5df4582db9e9bf4672ba50567dba16c6ccf174c474
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Host: cvm.tencentcloudapi.com
X-TC-Action: DescribeInstances
X-TC-Version: 2017-03-12
X-TC-Timestamp: 1539084154
X-TC-Region: ap-guangzhou
The following example shows you how to structure an HTTP POST (application/json) request:
https://cvm.tencentcloudapi.com/
Authorization: TC3-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=AKID********************************/2018-05-30/cvm/tc3_request, SignedHeaders=content-type;host, Signature=582c400e06b5924a6f2b5d7d672d79c15b13162d9279b0855cfba6789a8edb4c
Content-Type: application/json
Host: cvm.tencentcloudapi.com
X-TC-Action: DescribeInstances
X-TC-Version: 2017-03-12
X-TC-Timestamp: 1527672334
X-TC-Region: ap-guangzhou
{"Offset":0,"Limit":10}
Example of an HTTP POST (multipart/form-data) request structure (only supported by specific APIs):
https://cvm.tencentcloudapi.com/
Authorization: TC3-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=AKID********************************/2018-05-30/cvm/tc3_request, SignedHeaders=content-type;host, Signature=582c400e06b5924a6f2b5d7d672d79c15b13162d9279b0855cfba6789a8edb4c
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=58731222010402
Host: cvm.tencentcloudapi.com
X-TC-Action: DescribeInstances
X-TC-Version: 2017-03-12
X-TC-Timestamp: 1527672334
X-TC-Region: ap-guangzhou
--58731222010402
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="Offset"
0
--58731222010402
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="Limit"
10
--58731222010402--
Common parameters for Signature Algorithm v1To adopt the HmacSHA1 and HmacSHA256 signature methods, common parameters must be put into the request string, as shown below:
Parameter Name
Type
Required
Description
Action
String
Yes
The name of the API for the desired operation. For the specific value, see the description of common parameter Action in the input parameters in related API documentation. For example, the API for querying the CVM instance list is DescribeInstances.
Region
String
Yes
Region parameter, which is used to identify the region to which the data you want to work with belongs. For values supported for an API, see the description of common parameter Region in the input parameters in related API documentation. Note: This parameter is not required for some APIs (which will be indicated in related API documentation), and will not take effect even if it is passed.
Timestamp
Integer
Yes
The current UNIX timestamp that records the time when the API request was initiated, for example, 1529223702. If the difference between the value and the current system time is too large, a signature expiration error may occur.
Nonce
Integer
Yes
A random positive integer used along with Timestamp to prevent replay attacks.
SecretId
String
Yes
The identifying SecretId obtained on the Cloud API Key page. A SecretId corresponds to a unique SecretKey which is used to generate the request signature (Signature).
Signature
String
Yes
Request signature used to verify the validity of this request. This is calculated based on the actual input parameters. For more information about how this is calculated, see the API authentication documentation.
Version
String
Yes
API version of the action. For the valid values, see the description of the common input parameter Version in the API documentation. For example, the version of CVM is 2017-03-12.
SignatureMethod
String
No
Signature method. Currently, only HmacSHA256 and HmacSHA1 are supported. The HmacSHA256 algorithm is used to verify the signature only when this parameter is specified as HmacSHA256. In other cases, the signature is verified with HmacSHA1.
Token
String
No
The token used for a temporary certificate. It must be used with a temporary key. You can obtain the temporary key and token by calling a CAM API. No token is required for a long-term key.
Assuming you want to query the list of Cloud Virtual Machine instances in the Guangzhou region, the request structure in the form of request URL, request header and request body may be as follows:
Example of an HTTP GET request structure:https://cvm.tencentcloudapi.com/?Action=DescribeInstances&Version=2017-03-12&SignatureMethod=HmacSHA256&Timestamp=1527672334&Signature=37ac2f4fde00b0ac9bd9eadeb459b1bbee224158d66e7ae5fcadb70b2d181d02&Region=ap-guangzhou&Nonce=23823223&SecretId=AKID********************************
Host: cvm.tencentcloudapi.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Example of an HTTP POST request structure:
https://cvm.tencentcloudapi.com/
Host: cvm.tencentcloudapi.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Action=DescribeInstances&Version=2017-03-12&SignatureMethod=HmacSHA256&Timestamp=1527672334&Signature=37ac2f4fde00b0ac9bd9eadeb459b1bbee224158d66e7ae5fcadb70b2d181d02&Region=ap-guangzhou&Nonce=23823223&SecretId=AKID********************************

Tencent Hunyuan 3D Common Issues
Service Form of Tencent HY 3D GlobalProvide API technology services.How is the Service Charged?Please visit Tencent HY 3D Global Billing Overview to learn about billing details.Is a Free Test Supported?After the first-time activation of Tencent HY Large Model service, a free quota will be automatically issued for your test experience. The free quota will be provided using a one-time free resource package and deducted first during billing and settlement. When the free quota is exhausted, Tencent Cloud will inform you in advance about the remaining free quota count. Please pay attention to avoid excess usage and entering into billing settlement. The free resource pack's validity period is 1 year. If the resource pack is not used up within 1 year after service activation, it will expire and become invalid.Content Moderation AvailabilityTo ensure content security, Tencent HY 3D Global performs text content moderation and image content moderation by default on input content to block non-compliant content.Please note, as a deep synthesis service provider, you must fulfill the primary responsibility for information security, build supportive security and controllable technical measures, and do not use Tencent HY service to generate or synthesise any content prohibited by appliable law or regulations.Checking for Retrieved Results InfoTask status description: WAIT: Waiting, RUN: Executing, FAIL: Task failure, DONE: Task success.When querying with the QueryHunyuanTo3DJob API, it will return Status (task status). When Status is FAIL or DONE, the task has been processed.If Status is DONE: the 3D file can be accessed through the returned ResultFile3Ds parameter.If Status is FAIL: the error cause can be obtained through the returned ErrorCode and ErrorMessage parameters.If Status is WAIT or RUN: it indicates no result info is retrieved and you need to continue pulling.Is Private Deployment Method Supported?Not supported.
